writeup: TIC 319039747 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 1.0169 days. TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse that dims the system by 1.83%, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 177.6 using the Box Least Squares algorithm. No secondary eclipse was detected. Pixel-level image analysis confirms the signal originates near the target location, with a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 21.4, though the centroid offset of 1.4 arcseconds warrants consideration. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, suggesting it may be previously unknown. The machine learning screening score of 0.31 indicates moderate confidence that this represents a genuine astrophysical source rather than instrumental noise.
